extraction.notes: Reconciliation is from the 3/31/2023 column of the FFO/Core FFO table (S-7). Subtotals verified: 41,964 + adjustments = 16,254 FFO; 16,254 + adjustments = 19,542 Core FFO. Company reports no AFFO metric. Zero-amount lines (loss on extinguishment of debt and technology implementation costs) show '—' for the current quarter and are included as 0. Shown 'Technology implementation costs' under severance_restructuring as the closest category (software transition); amount is zero so no effect. 'Other miscellaneous items' is footnoted as (gain) loss on investments. The diluted FFO/Core FFO per-share figures add back preferred unit dividends of 160 (not included in the subtotal lines above); the diluted share count 18,359 reproduces $0.89 (16,414/18,359) and $1.07 (19,702/18,359). Ffo_total and core_total use the pre-dividend subtotals that the adjustments reconcile to. The Adjusted EBITDA and same-store pages were not used.
